Hyperspan Website

This repository contains the Hyperspan website and documentation. Hyperspan is a
dynamic web framework built with TypeScript and Vite.

Use the documentation pages below as the source of truth for features, API
usage, and examples. Docs and blog pages return markdown for known LLMs and AI bots,
and HTML pages for all other user agents.

Base URL for documentation: https://www.hyperspan.dev
